blocks.tamil_translation: ”. Hearing this, Hazrat Amr (RA) said, “There is none worthy of worship except Allah Ta'ala. I bear witness that you are certainly the Messenger of Allah Ta'ala. I believe in all the halal and haram that you have brought. Even if these matters are hateful to many peoples!” The Prophet ﷺ, expressing his happiness, said, “Amr, welcome to you.” “Ya Rasulallah, may my mother and father be sacrificed for you; send me to my people. Just as Allah has shown favour to me through you, may Allah Ta'ala not show favour to my people through me?” Hazrat Amr (RA) requested. So the Prophet ﷺ sent me to my people, and he sent me with the advice: deal with them in a gentle manner, speak only correct and gentle words, do not speak harsh words or behave with bad character, and do not have pride or envy.” I came to my people and said, “O Banu Rifa'ah, O people of Juhainah, I have come to you as the envoy of the Messenger of Allah Ta'ala. I invite you to Jannah and warn you about Jahannam. Protect blood (do not kill anyone unjustly). Keep ties with relatives. Worship Allah Ta'ala alone, give up idol worship, perform Hajj of Baitullah, fast one month out of the twelve months — this is what I command you.” Whoever accepts these will get Jannah, and whoever does not accept will get Jahannam.
